results.note: ČTK via České noviny reports the full-day strike at ČT and ČRo began after midnight on 3 Nov, and ČT24 confirms the 24-hour strike went ahead as called, so it was not called off or postponed.
ČTK via České noviny reports the government approved the Koncepce výstavby Armády ČR do roku 2040 at its 2 Nov meeting; the resolution list on vlada.gov.cz/ODOK was not read.

ČT24 reports on 2 Nov that the government approved the 2.39 billion CZK State Fund for Audiovisual budget for next year per the original proposal, as Babiš announced after the meeting; the resolution list was not read.
Investing.com on 2 Nov gives the October Czech manufacturing PMI as 55.0, up from 53.5 in September, and InstaForex gives the same figure; the S&P Global release itself was not read.
Investing.com on 2 Nov gives the October PMI as 55.0, which is at or above 53.5, and InstaForex matches; the S&P Global release itself was not read.
ČTK via České noviny, published 2 Nov 14:13, gives the diesel cap for 3 Nov as CZK 49.35, down 10 haléřů from 49.45, so it is not higher; mfcr.cz was not read.
WRVO, the Rome Sentinel and CNY Central all report the 2 Nov Rome NY rally as headlined by JD Vance with Donald Trump Jr. and Chris Wright; none reports the President appearing in person.
Democracy Docket, dated 1 Nov 2026, reports Judge Gleason dismissed the DOJ suit for lack of standing and rejected ballot segregation, so no such order issued; docket and named outlets not read.
ISM's own PR Newswire release of 2 Nov 2026, 10:00 ET, is headlined Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% for October 2026.
ISM's PR Newswire release of 2 Nov 2026 gives the October Manufacturing PMI as 55.5, above 55.0.
Apple Newsroom release dated 2 Nov 2026 reports fiscal Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion for the quarter ended 26 Sep 2026.

Vozpopuli's and elDiario.es's front pages of 2 Nov 2026 both show Puente still minister and Sanchez backing him, with no resignation or dismissal; La Moncloa and the BOE were not checked and those pages do not cover late evening.
Ryanair's RNS of 2 Nov 2026 (via Reuters/TradingView, confirmed by RTE) reports H1 FY27 profit after tax of EUR 2,147.6m, above EUR 2.10bn.

UKMTO's own page refused scripted reading; gCaptain, citing UKMTO, puts a tanker struck by two projectiles 72 nm east of Ras Al Khafji at 2347 UTC on 1 November, which is 03:47 Gulf time on 2 November, and Bloomberg via gCaptain confirms the strike in the Persian Gulf.

Witkoff named 10-11 November on X, which the Kyiv Independent (published 01:51 Kyiv time on 3 Nov) dates to 3 November while RFE/RL says Monday 2 November; the post's exact time was not seen, so I read it as after 23:59 Kyiv time on the Kyiv Independent's date and the window's Kyiv clock.

The Jerusalem Post reports that on Monday Sohlberg rejected a Likud demand for an investigative briefing before the results were approved and said those entitled could challenge in court, with no filing reported; I read a demand for a briefing as not seeking annulment, a re-vote or a recount and not as contesting the results.

ČTK reports Babiš at the 2 Nov press conference saying the coalition will settle the form of funding at second reading around 15 January, and no leader announced an agreed model; held is false because the settlement expected from the Monday council moved to January and no report found says the council met.

trybunal.gov.pl was unreachable, so on two outlets: prawo.pl (31 Oct) gives the budget as the stated purpose with immunity only a possibility, Notes from Poland (3 Nov) reports the Assembly's decisions as budget and disciplinary panels, and neither reports a statement in the window that the motions were on the agenda.

Primary channels not checked directly; the Danas Student List feed and the N1 front page read on 4 Nov carry no named prime ministerial candidate, and Vučić's 3 Oct claim about Šoškić is not a naming by the List.

ČTK on 3 Nov reports KHNP still drawing up an alternative plan for choosing a new builder, with its 29 Oct statement only preparing the agreement's termination and a tender, so neither step was confirmed as done in the window.
The Constitutional Court's news page lists nothing on this request through 2 Nov, and no ČTK or other report of a decision on the request filed in October was found.
